description: This is a Go source file defining an HTTP API controller for managing Android Cuttlefish virtual devices. It includes route setup, request handlers for various operations such as creating, listing, starting, stopping CVDs, handling artifacts, and debugging.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration structure holding paths, service URL, and user info for the orchestrator.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main HTTP API controller managing routes and request handlers.

classes.name: fetchArtifactsHandler
classes.description: Handler for the /artifacts POST route to fetch artifacts.

classes.name: createCVDHandler
classes.description: Handler for creating new CVD instances.

classes.name: listCVDsHandler
classes.description: Handler for listing existing CVDs.

classes.name: execCVDCommandHandler
classes.description: Generic handler for executing commands on CVDs (start, stop, remove).

classes.name: createSnapshotHandler
classes.description: Handler for creating snapshots of CVDs.

classes.name: startCVDHandler
classes.description: Handler for starting a CVD instance.

classes.name: getCVDLogsHandler
classes.description: Handler for retrieving CVD logs.

classes.name: listOperationsHandler
classes.description: Handler for listing ongoing operations.

classes.name: getOperationHandler
classes.description: Handler for retrieving the status of a specific operation.

classes.name: getOperationResultHandler
classes.description: Handler for retrieving the result of a completed operation.

classes.name: waitOperationHandler
classes.description: Handler for waiting on an operation to complete with timeout.

classes.name: createCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Handler to generate a bug report for a CVD, optionally including adb bugreport.

classes.name: downloadCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Handler to download a generated CVD bug report ZIP.

classes.name: deleteCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Handler to delete a CVD bug report.

classes.name: createUploadDirectoryHandler
classes.description: Handler to create a new user artifact upload directory.

classes.name: listUploadDirectoriesHandler
classes.description: Handler to list all user artifact upload directories.

classes.name: createUpdateUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: Handler to upload or update a user artifact chunk.

classes.name: extractUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: Handler to trigger extraction of a user artifact asynchronously.

classes.name: getDebugVariablesHandler
classes.description: Handler to retrieve debug variables info.

classes.name: okHandler
classes.description: Handler that responds with 200 OK for health/status checks.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Implemented by handler structs to process incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: httpHandler
methods.description: Wraps a handler implementation into an http.Handler with logging and error handling.

methods.name: replyJSON
methods.description: Serialize object as JSON and write with status code.
